content.title: Hallucinogens
content.text: Summary Read the full fact sheet Psychedelics are drugs that alter a person’s perception of reality and cause them to see or hear things that do not exist or are distorted.These drugs are either synthetically manufactured or derived from plants.People who regularly use psychedelics may experience ‘flashbacks’, which can occur days, weeks, months or even years after taking the drug.
